Privacy Policy

Last updated: May 2026

Information We Collect

We collect business contact information (name, email, company name) when you sign up for services or request a consultation. This information is provided voluntarily by you.

We use your information to deliver services, send invoices, communicate about your projects, and improve our AI agents. We do not sell your information to third parties.

Business data submitted for AI processing is used solely to generate your deliverables. AI agents do not retain or train on your proprietary data. All data is handled in accordance with industry-standard security practices.

We retain client data for the duration of your active subscription plus 90 days. You may request data deletion at any time by contacting us.

We use Stripe for payment processing. Your payment data is handled by Stripe and subject to their privacy policy.
